Demo General Insurance Company Limited
Demo Group Health Shield - Policy Wording and Schedule Extract
UIN: DEMHLGP26002V012526
Master Policy No. DG/GHS/2026/004567    Certificate No. DG/GHS/2026/004567/0042

SECTION F. PREMIUM, RENEWAL AND CANCELLATION

F.1 Premium for Certificate DG/GHS/2026/004567/0042
Base premium: Rs. 78,000 per policy year. GST at 18%: Rs. 14,040. Total premium: Rs. 92,040. Premium is payable annually in advance by the Policyholder.
A loading of 15% on the base premium has been applied for Insured Person Vikram Verma on account of declared type 2 diabetes.
Premium discounts applicable: online purchase discount of 5% and long-term discount of 7.5% on the base premium.
Premium for dependent parents is determined on the age band of each parent at inception of the certificate, and the premium changes when a parent enters a higher age band at renewal.
Premium may be paid by cheque, NEFT/RTGS or online payment.

F.2 Renewal of Policy
The Master Policy is renewed annually on the request of the Policyholder received before the expiry date. The Company shall not deny renewal on the ground that claims were made in the preceding policy years. Renewal may be refused only on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or non-disclosure of material facts. Claims arising in the grace period after expiry shall not be covered.
The individual policy issued on conversion under Clause F.5 shall be renewable for life, subject to the grounds of fraud and misrepresentation stated above.

F.3 Revision of Premium and Terms
The premium rates may be revised only with the prior approval of the IRDAI, and the revised premium shall apply from the next renewal after notice to the Policyholder. No Insured Person shall be loaded on renewal on the ground of his or her own claims. Changes to the terms of this policy shall take effect only after approval of the IRDAI and written notice of 3 months to the Policyholder.
The sum insured may be enhanced at renewal on the request of the Policyholder, subject to underwriting, and the waiting periods shall apply afresh to the enhanced portion.
=== PAGE BREAK ===
F.4 Withdrawal of Product
If the Company withdraws this product, the Policyholder shall be informed and the Insured Persons shall be offered migration to a suitable product with continuity benefits preserved.

F.5 Conversion to Individual Policy
An Insured Person who ceases to be an employee of the Policyholder, and the dependents covered with him or her, may apply to the Company for an individual health policy without a fresh medical underwriting, and the period of continuous cover under this Master Policy shall be credited towards waiting periods. The application must be made within 30 days of the date of leaving employment.
Where the individual policy is purchased for a 2-year term, a multi-year discount of 7.5% on the premium shall be allowed.

F.6 Cancellation
The Policyholder may cancel the Master Policy by giving 30 days' written notice, and the Company shall refund the premium as per the short period scale below. Period on risk up to 1 month: refund of 75% of premium; up to 3 months: 50%; up to 6 months: 25%; above 6 months: no refund. No refund shall be allowed if a claim has been made.
The Company may cancel the policy on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or non-cooperation by giving 30 days' written notice, and shall refund the premium for the unexpired period.

F.7 Tax Benefit
Premium paid may be eligible for deduction under Section 80D of the Income-tax Act, 1961, subject to the tax laws in force and to payment by a mode other than cash.
